_description: Backtrader replay of pre-recorded daily portfolio weights (the post-softmax targets stage 3 produced). No model loading, no state reconstruction - the strategy reads weights from inputs.weights_csv and rebalances via order_target_percent each bar. Same-day-close fills via coc=true. A cash_buffer keeps a fraction of capital unallocated for headroom; sell_first sorts orders so sells execute before buys within a bar.

inputs._notes: weights_csv is produced by 03_backtest.py (one column per ticker, indexed by date, weights are the env's post-softmax actions). Change 'ppo' to 'a2c' (or whichever algo) to replay a different recorded run. trade_pickle supplies OHLCV per ticker - indicators are NOT needed by this stage. data/full_data.pkl covers the entire downloaded history (2008-2021) which is what walk-forward mode needs; data/trade_data.pkl only covers the single-split trade window. auto_slice=true clips the trade DataFrame to the date range of weights_csv automatically - usually the right thing. Set auto_slice=false and provide explicit trade_start_date / trade_end_date to override.

commission._notes: type='percentage' uses bt.broker.setcommission(commission=value, percabs=True, stocklike=stocklike). type='fixed' uses absolute $ per share. Set value=0 to disable.

slippage._notes: type='percentage' -> set_slippage_perc; type='fixed' -> set_slippage_fixed; type='none' disables slippage.

broker._notes: coc=true (cheat-on-close): market orders submitted in next() match the SAME bar's close. This is what 'execute at close of day t' means for the recorded weights - target the weight on bar d_t and have it filled at close(d_t). Set coc=false to fall back to default behaviour (orders fill at the OPEN of the next bar = t+1).

execution._notes: cash_buffer scales recorded weights by (1 - cash_buffer) before submission so the broker has headroom for slippage and fractional-share rounding. sell_first sorts orders by (target_weight - current_weight) ascending so sells (negative delta) hit the broker before buys (positive delta) and free cash within the same bar. min_weight_delta suppresses no-op rebalances.

rebalance._notes: Inference-only rebalance cadence (Approach A from METHODOLOGY.md Appendix A). When cadence != 'daily', the WeightReplayStrategy still receives the agent's daily target weights but only acts on configured rebalance days; on non-rebalance days the portfolio drifts naturally with prices. The agent's training and stage-3 backtest are UNAFFECTED - this is post-hoc execution discipline only, the cheap diagnostic for 'does rebalancing less often improve net-of-cost results?'. cadence: 'daily' (DEFAULT, behaves identically to the previous pipeline), 'weekly' (act on weekly_day, or the next trading day if that day is missed), 'monthly' (act on or after monthly_day in each new month). weekly_day uses ISO weekday names ('MON' - 'SUN'); 'FRI' is the typical end-of-week practitioner cadence. monthly_day is clamped to [1, 28] to avoid month-end issues. The B-only no-trade band (min_weight_delta above) still applies on rebalance bars - the cadence only authorises a rebalance attempt; per-ticker filtering happens after.

pyfolio._notes: Requires pyfolio installed; emits returns/positions/transactions DataFrames.

plot._notes: Renders a clean strategy-level equity curve via matplotlib. overlay_djia rescales source_config.baselines.dji_ticker to the strategy's starting equity and dashes it on the same axes.
